translations.web: “Defend the weak, the poor, and the fatherless. Maintain the rights of the poor and oppressed.
translations.bsb: Defend the cause of the weak and fatherless; uphold the rights of the afflicted and oppressed.
translations.kjv: Defend the poor and fatherless: do justice to the afflicted and needy.
translations.asv: Judge the poor and fatherless: Do justice to the afflicted and destitute.
